> ./bin/ta




























────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ta — pick a subcommand

▶ create — Create one or more records (fails if any exists); mirrors MCP tool `create`.
  delete — Remove one or more records or files; mirrors MCP tool `delete`.
  get — Read one or more records by id, or every record under an id prefix; optionally extract declared field values
  index — Manage the runtime record-type index at .ta/index.toml
  init — Bootstrap a project directory with a schema and MCP configs
  list-sections — Enumerate record ids under a scope; mirrors MCP tool `list_sections`.
  move — Move (or copy) a record from one id to another; mirrors MCP tool `move`.
  schema — Inspect or mutate the resolved schema; mirrors MCP tool `schema`.
  search — Structured + regex search across records; mirrors MCP tool `search`.
  template — Manage the ~/.ta/schema.toml template library
  update — PATCH one or more existing records; mirrors MCP tool `update`.

j/k move  enter pick  q abort
